JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. PLAINTIFF, B.D. THAKOR, SHALL HAVE JUDGMENT AGAINST RONALD HUGHES FOR THE SUM OF $1,460.00 AND RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF PREMISES AT 520 SOUTH VAN NESS, #223, SAN FRANCISCO. A WRIT OF POSSESSION SHALL ISSUE IMMEDIATELY BUT SHALL BE STAYED UNTIL 11-30-94, 9AM. NO OTHER PERSONS CAN CLAIM A RIGHT TO POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES THROUGH THE DEFENDANT. ALL PARTIES WILL RELEASE ALL CLAIMS AGAINST EACH OTHER. IF DEFENDANT, RONALD HUGHES, MEETS ALL THE ABOVE CONDITIONS INCLUDING MOVING OUT IN A TIMELY FASHION, THE JUDGMENT SHALL BE DEEMED SATISFIED IN FULL.
